_doc: Source of truth for how texture groups import. First matching group wins. `apply` writes it into the .import files, `check` verifies, generators read it (tools/godot/tex_groups.py: group_params). Only the listed keys are set; every other key in a .import is left alone.

never.reason: her body maps: another lane is replacing her body
scene imports are out of scope, except the NPC packages' glbs (group npc_packages)

groups.name: her_body
groups.why: Her house body's embedded albedo and normal map (2048 each, 21 MB uncompressed with mipmaps) embedded as Basis Universal, VRAM compressed at load (tester s8 item 2, judged A/B at the game camera). publish_house.py writes body.glb.import from heroine.glb's params: run apply after a publish.

groups.name: her_maps
groups.why: Her freckles, cavity and brow paints (2048 RGBA8, 16-21 MB each) VRAM compressed (BPTC); mipmaps left as each file has them (tester s8 item 2, judged A/B at the game camera).

groups.name: npc_packages
groups.why: The Marionette NPC packages' embedded maps (3 x 2048 each: about 67 MB a body uncompressed with mipmaps) embedded as Basis Universal, VRAM compressed at load. Her body is not a package (art/people/body_p1: never). The risen are den foes, not seen compressed by a judge yet.

groups.name: den
groups.why: Den floor, bank, decals: VRAM compressed (BPTC) with mipmaps; normal maps flagged as normal maps (texture importer only; 2d_array_texture has no such key).

groups.name: people_spark
groups.why: Her skin spark map is sampled filter_linear (shaders/heroine_skin.gdshader spark_map): mipmaps would never be used (judge a54a554ad332862b7, 24 Nov).

groups.name: people
groups.why: Outfit and head textures: VRAM compressed with mipmaps.

groups.name: world
groups.why: World textures: VRAM compressed with mipmaps.

groups.name: fx_longcut_hot
groups.why: The long cut's hot edge (decal path, lit only in each crack tile's first frames) was not seen by the compression judge (24 Nov): kept lossless, ~7 MB VRAM, until a judge sees it compressed.

groups.name: fx_longcut
groups.why: Longcut fx sheets: VRAM compressed; mipmaps left as each file has them.
